summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release from its Capital Markets Day 2026. The company announced it will double its 2026 share buy-back to USD 3 billion and introduce a more predictable buy-back framework from 2027, targeting USD 2-4 billion annually. It also aims to grow the quarterly cash dividend by more than 5% per share. These capital return plans are part of a broader strategic update, not an immediate tender offer or other special situation. No specific price per share, premium, or close date is given. Watch for execution of buy-backs and dividend growth versus stated targets.
